Quad - [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px]]1,800 (Hard) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3.25) |cash = {{Money|280}} every 20% health |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Peck from Above}}''' - '''Long Ducky''' hits a random tower or unit in its range of 7.5, stunning it for 6 seconds or dealing 1,500 damage to it. |ability1_cooldown = 8 }} ==Description== The '''Long Ducky''' is an enemy encountered in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has high health for its debut and walks at an average speed. The '''Long Ducky''' has a ''Peck from Above'' ability, where it targets a random tower or unit in its range of 7.5, then pecks it, stunning it for 6 seconds or dealing 1,500 damage to it. ==Logbook Description== "''Long Ducky uses their long neck to attack and swipe at enemies. Born a little strange, Long Ducky stands out from the flock but was the favorite of Mother Ducky. The other ducks love playing games by climbing up Long Ducky's neck and hanging from their head like a flagpole. When you pull Long Ducky's head back and let it go, it makes a sound just like a sprung doorstop.''" ==Appearance== The '''Long Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes, an orange beak and orange shoes. It has a very long neck that wobbles. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers with long range such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] are effective against the '''Long Ducky'''. **As the first two have the [[Stun Immunity]], the '''Long Ducky''' cannot stun them. **These towers should also be buffed by [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:LongDuckyPeckfromAbove.ogg]] {{!}}When the '''Long Ducky''' performs its ''Peck from Above'' ability {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1LongDucky.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLongDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Long Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Long Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LongDuckyIconIG.png|'''Long Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. DuckyIconIG.png|'''Long Ducky''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Long Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Long Ducky''' floats above the ground when made larger or smaller. **{{Bug}} '''Long Ducky''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *'''28 May 2025''' - [[v1.65.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''2 July 2025''' - [[v1.69.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Long Ducky’s''' icon uses the [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky’s]] icon. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' re-added to the main game, now appears in [[Bathroom Approach]]. **Health decreased from 1,250 to 700 in Easy difficulty. **Health decreased from 3,250 to 1,400 in Hard difficulty. **Speed increased from 3 to 3.25. **Cash given changed from {{Money|600}} every 50% health lost to {{Money|280}} every 20% health lost in Easy difficulty. **Cash given changed from {{Money|1,000}} every 50% health lost to {{Money|280}} every 20% health lost in Hard difficulty. **''Peck From Above'' range increased from 5 to 7.5. **''Peck From Above'' stun time increased from 2 to 6. **''Peck From Above'' damage increased from 150 to 1,500. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer floats above the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BathroomApproach|[[Aged Eggroll 1]], [[Aged Eggroll 2]], [[Aged Eggroll 3]] & [[Grandmother Ducky]]|Wave 16|Long Ducky|Wave 17|[[Operator Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Operator Ducky]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Long Ducky}}
